## 1. EXECUTIVE VERDICT

**Are all scenarios valid? NO — but the failure is contained and almost entirely pre-publication.**

- **Ground-truth correctness of the data that actually ships is sound**, with exactly **one blocking
  exception** (square4 `remove_network`, §3-B1) that lives in the v0 core default path.
- **All 13 quiet/reroute families are individually oracle-PASS**: clean D4+D10-only signature, empty
  no_op twins, 10× byte-deterministic, GT matches the committed artifact and live re-run, **not
  false-quiet**. BUT — and this is decisive — **none of the 13 are wired into the published question
  base.** `build_generated_suite_multi` (scenarios.py:697) ships only `ipc/leak/lp/scale`; grep of the
  paper TR for these mechanisms returns empty. So their defects are reviewer-credibility wounds, not
  result-corrupting ones. **Every quiet-family blocker is therefore a pre-ship blocker, not a
  data-corruption blocker.**
- **Fraction valid:** of the **13 quiet families**, 10 are net-VALID, 3 carry MAJOR/MINOR issues
  (igp_summary MAJOR, origin_code MINOR-issues with major gameability, med_far_as MINOR). Of the
  **11 loud/baseline families**, 7 net-VALID, 1 INVALID (square4, blocking), 3 MAJOR (blackhole,
  clos_summary fake-oracle, plus square4).

**What blocks publication right now:**
1. **square4 `remove_network` latent false-quiet** in the shipped v0 generator default (§3-B1) — the
   only blocker touching a shippable code path.
2. **igp_summary mechanism mis-attribution + self-contradicting committed artifacts** (§3-B2 /
   §4-M1) — blocks the *distinctness claim* and the *KB-integrity claim*, both paper-bound.

**What is NOT fully reviewed (state plainly, do not imply pass):**
- **Loud half: every loud/baseline family was reviewed `1/1` — a SINGLE pass each, no second lens.**
  `leak_ms_reroute`, `lp_waypoint`, `ipc`, `scale_deagg`, `clos_summary`, `mgmt_lockout`, `blackhole`,
  `ecmp4`, `waypoint4`, `ospf_core6`, `square4` carry **oracle-lens only — no design-lens cross-check.**
  Treat all loud-family verdicts as **single-lens / PARTIAL coverage.**
- **origin_code design lens returned PARTIAL** on its grounding-gap finding (severity reproduced, but
  the reviewer's grep evidence was wrong — 17 hits not 2). Net origin_code = MINOR_ISSUES with an
  **unresolved provisional cause-attribution flag** (test_generator_family23.py:11-15) the architect
  has **not** cleared. Do not state "ORIGIN is the decisive change" until cleared.
- **The κ≥0.7 human-validation gate has touched NONE of these families.** `meta.hand_validated=false`
  on all 12 square4 tasks; no quiet family has a human-labeled subset. **No number may ship until κ
  runs.** This is a standing publication blocker independent of scenario validity.

## 3. BLOCKING / INVALID (consolidated, confirmed, with FALSE-QUIET flags)

### B1 — square4 `remove_network` is a latent FALSE-QUIET trap in the SHIPPED v0 default ⛔ FALSE-QUIET
**Files:** `netbrace/tasks/safety/generator.py:42` (GenerationSpec.intents default), `:85-88` (_combos);
`netbrace/batfish/oracle.py:83` (v0 BatfishOracle grades MAIN RIB only).
**Confirmed (live, pinned digest):** The v0 `BatfishOracle` has no BGP-RIB / D9 term. The square4
baseline's static routes (AD=1) keep every loopback in the **main** RIB pre and post, so removing
`network 10.0.0.1/32` is a real **4-element BGP-best-path withdrawal** (`bgpRib` BEST `[r1,r2,r3,r4]→[]`)
that the v0 oracle reports as **ZERO blast radius**. It is masked today only because the shipped suite is
hand-trimmed to 12 `shut_neighbor` tasks — but the **generator default still emits 4 `remove_network`
tasks**, so the standard `generate → oracle → commit` workflow commits wrong (empty) GT. Worse: the
model-facing prompt tells the model the change stops BGP origination, so a model that *correctly* flags
the 4-element withdrawal is scored a **false positive** while a wrong "static backs it up, empty radius"
answer scores a perfect pass — the exact pathology NetBrace exists to catch, baked into its own default.
**Fix:** route `remove_network` through `ExtendedOracle` with `bgp_watch_prefixes` set so
`_bgp_withdrawn_diff` (extended_oracle.py:222-237) catches the D9 withdrawal (live-confirmed: 4 elements);
**OR** drop `remove_network` from generator.py:42 default + `_combos` until D9-aware. Add a regression test
asserting `remove_network` GT is non-empty. **Land before any `remove_network` task is generated.**

### B2 — igp_summary mechanism mis-attribution (distinctness-blocking) + contradicting committed artifacts
**Files:** `generator_igp_summary.py:36-40` (docstring), render path (no `area range` ever emitted —
grep confirms zero `area...range` render lines); `knowledge/corpus/batfish/batfish_verified_facts.md:154-163`;
`knowledge/corpus/noc/ospf_summary_cost_nexthop_reroute.md`; frozen-set catalog Family-1.
**Confirmed (this session):** Two committed artifacts contradict each other on the **same digest, same date**:
- generator_igp_summary.py:39 claims the **bare** `area N range A.B.C.D/M cost C` is "PARTIALLY_UNRECOGNIZED on the digest (verified 2026-06-14)."
- batfish_verified_facts.md:154-159 states the **bare** form **IS MODELED** — parses `CUMULUS_CONCATENATED` with **zero init issues**, appears as `ospfIA`, flips the next-hop, **and suppresses the /32** (the "linchpin," lines 160-163). Only the `advertise cost` variant is unrecognized (line 167).

The generator **conflated** the bare form (modeled) with the `advertise cost` form (unrecognized), then used
the false excuse to ship a bare `ip ospf cost` on an ABR backbone interface — i.e. it **builds no
summarization at all** while its name (`igp-summary-default-nexthop`), corpus title, frozen catalog, and
docstring distinctness argument (Type-3 §12.4.3 vs §16.1 SPF, /32-suppression as the linchpin) all rest on
summarization that is **absent**. The /32 is NOT suppressed; the only difference from igp_metric is the area
boundary. A reviewer diffing corpus-vs-code hits this in minutes.
**Why blocking (not just major):** the GT is correct and gradeable — nothing mis-grades — but this is
**blocking for the distinctness claim and the KB-integrity claim**, both paper-bound, and one of the two
committed artifacts is provably wrong on a correctness-critical tool fact.
**Fix (KB MANDATES option a):** rebuild with the real `area {area} range {supernet}/M cost C` on each ABR
(verified-facts:154-163 says it parses AND suppresses the /32 on this digest), making it a genuine inter-area
Type-3 + LPM-suppression mechanism distinct from igp_metric. **OR** re-title corpus + catalog + docstring to
"inter-area Type-3 metric displacement," state the /32 is NOT suppressed, and count it as the **same**
IGP-metric mechanism at a different locus (an axis, not a 14th mechanism). **Either way, first re-run the
live parse on the pinned digest for both forms and record ONE authoritative status** — fix whichever artifact
is wrong (generator docstring or verified-facts:154-163).

**No other FALSE-QUIET landmines were triggered.** Every quiet family's bypass/no_op contrast empirically
proves the oracle is not silent-empty. The known landmines (always-compare-med, PBR, FlowSpec, VRF-leak,
ADD-PATH, ECMP-hash, `area...advertise cost`, `default-information originate`) are all correctly **avoided**,
not relied upon. origin_code/med_far_as/remove_dead_prepend exploit the **inverse** of the always-compare-med
landmine (Batfish's unconditional MED comparison) and are gradeable.

## 4. MAJOR ISSUES (deduped)

### M1 — Self-contradicting KB on `area range cost` parse status (paper-bound integrity)
Same root as B2's second half. Two committed files give mutually exclusive statements about the same syntax
on the same digest/date. A reviewer auditing the KB finds it in minutes. **Fix:** authoritative live re-run;
correct the wrong file.

### M2 — Three docstrings assert a FALSE Batfish MED-comparability mechanism
**Files:** `generator_med_far_as.py:25-31,65`; `generator_remove_dead_prepend.py:16-18,60-66,99-103`
(the latter even leaked into the **determinism contract**, line 100-101); echoed in origin_code prose.
**Confirmed:** these claim Batfish honors the RFC 4271 §9.1.2.2(c) same-neighbor-AS MED gate. The project's own
`batfish_verified_facts.md:140` (verified against `BgpRib.java:209`, a bare `Long.compare`) says the **opposite**:
Batfish compares MED **unconditionally**, behaving like always-compare-med by default. **Outcomes are unaffected**
(single-neighbor-AS topology + strict MED gap decide either way), so this is a rationale/doc error — but it is a
"they don't understand their own oracle" rejection on a benchmark whose value proposition IS oracle correctness.
**Fix:** rewrite to state the MED is comparable under BOTH the real RFC gate AND Batfish's permissive comparator,
and that the mechanism decides on the MED **value** flip (immune to the always-compare-med false-quiet), not a
comparability flip. Correct the remove_dead_prepend determinism justification (determinism comes from the strict
gap, not the AS gate).

### M3 — origin_code: 100%-accurate gameability tell defeats the calibration twin
**Files:** `generator_origin_code.py:551-576` (_description), `:579-584` (_INTENTS_TEXT).
**Confirmed (live, 12 instances, seeds 600/700/800 × 4 combos):** the bypass diff ALWAYS adds/removes a line
naming the **customer prefix**; the no_op NEVER touches it (edits the own loopback /32). A purely syntactic
heuristic — "does the patch mention the intent's prefix?" — separates trap from calibration with **100%
accuracy, zero routing reasoning.** The no_op twin is meant to *prove* second-order reasoning; here it proves
nothing. **Fix:** make the no_op also edit the customer prefix's origination in a best-path-neutral way (swap
network↔redistribute on the non-deciding `alt`).

### M4 — origin_code RFC citation error (paper-bound the moment prose migrates)
**File:** `generator_origin_code.py` (multiple, incl. "§9.1.1 step 5/6", invented step numbers).
**Confirmed:** §9.1.1 is Phase-1 LOCAL_PREF degree-of-preference; the ORIGIN/AS_PATH/MED tie-breaks live in
**§9.1.2.2 "Breaking Ties (Phase 2)"** using lettered items, not numbered steps. (Same step-numbering slip
appears in igp_metric §9.1.2.2 "step 6" vs corpus "step (e)" and remove_dead_prepend.) Currently a code-comment
(absent from the TR), so **minor today / major the instant it migrates to the paper.** **Fix:** change all
`§9.1.1 step N` → `RFC 4271 §9.1.2.2 (Breaking Ties, Phase 2)`; drop invented step numbers across all reroute
docstrings.

### M5 — Engine-stack provenance gap on the committed v0 square4 GT
**Files:** all 12 square4 task records (`engine_version=None`, `meta.hand_validated=false`);
`runs/determinism_20260610_213818/report.json` (no digest, no pybatfish/Java/coordinator version, no init-issue counts).
**Confirmed.** GT bytes are only valid against `sha256:09817554db90`, yet nothing in the committed artifacts binds

## 5. DISTINCTNESS VERDICT — PARTIALLY DISTINCT (class, not 13 relabels; not 13 mechanisms)

The quiet half is **NOT** one mechanism × 13, but it is **NOT** 13 distinct mechanisms either. It collapses to
**~6 genuinely distinct decision surfaces** × two orthogonal coverage axes (subtraction-polarity; adversarial/
foreign/RR locus).

**The 6 distinct surfaces:** (1) IGP-metric tiebreak via `ip ospf cost`; (2) RIB administrative-distance
arbitration; (3) NEXT_HOP candidate-set validity; (4) LOCAL_PREF comparator; (5) AS_PATH-length comparator;
(6) MED comparator; plus (7) forwarding LPM (agg_collapse) — call it ~6-7.

**MERGE / DOWNGRADE to an axis (do NOT count as independent mechanisms):**
- **igp_summary → igp_metric.** As-built, identical `ip ospf cost` edit, identical cost constants
  {10,100,200,5,300} (verified igp_metric.py:124-130 vs igp_summary.py:155-162), identical 4-combo structure;
  only the area boundary differs. **Either build the real `area range cost` (KB says it works → genuine
  inter-area+LPM mechanism) or merge it.** This is the distinctness BLOCKER (§3-B2).
- **rr_bestpath → igp_metric (deciding step).** RR projection is a purity device; the flip is the igp-metric
  tiebreak. Keep ONLY as the "single-path-projection makes a hot-potato flip blind to a client" demo.
- **origin_code → med_far_as (outcome discriminator).** Final winner is the SAME unconditional-MED gap
  (50<200); the network↔redistribute swap is only the ORIGIN-tie preamble. Defensible ONLY if reframed as
  "same outcome reached two best-path steps deeper" AND grounded (§6) AND the gameability tell fixed (§4-M3)
  AND the provisional cause-flag cleared.
- **community_trigger → community_lp (LOCUS axis).** Same LOCAL_PREF step, same community→LP idiom.
- **remove_dead_prepend → subtraction-polarity axis** spanning AS_PATH→MED. Not a new step.

**KEEP as genuinely distinct:** redistribute_ad (RIB admin-distance), nexthop_elim (candidate validity),
agg_collapse (forwarding LPM), + one representative each of LOCAL_PREF / AS_PATH / MED / IGP-metric.

**Reframe for the paper:** STOP claiming "~13 distinct mechanisms" — that is a reviewer kill-shot. Claim what
the step-map supports: **the same D4+D10-only invariant reproduced across ~6 distinct decision surfaces × two
coverage axes.** "Decision-step diversity" is honest and still strong. Honest distinct count after fixes: **~11
if igp_summary is rebuilt; ~10-11 otherwise.**

**square4 (loud) distinctness:** N=1 mechanism × 12 directed (node,peer) permutations, all identical GT shape.
Report as **one mechanism with 12 permutations**, not 12 scenarios, or the headline N is inflated.
